Job Description:

Are you a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys influencing decisions, partnering with senior stakeholders and seeing the tangible impact of your work?

As our Finance Business Partner - Development Finance, you'll play a key role in supporting a portfolio of development and construction projects, providing financial insight, commercial guidance and strategic decision support that helps drive successful investment outcomes.

Working closely with Development and Construction leaders, you'll act as a trusted advisor, helping shape business decisions and supporting the financial performance of significant capital projects. You'll lead budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting, develop financial models and business cases, provide commercial insights and recommendations, and contribute to investment decisions and project governance. You'll also identify risks and opportunities, drive continuous improvement, and help strengthen financial discipline across projects.

This is a true business partnering opportunity where you'll move beyond traditional reporting to provide commercial challenge, influence key decisions and contribute to major investment outcomes.

Location: Wellington preferred, open to Auckland-based candidates.

Please click here to view position description.

Qualifications:

About You

You're a commercially astute finance professional who enjoys building relationships, influencing stakeholders and helping the business make better decisions. You bring a strong combination of technical expertise and commercial acumen and enjoy partnering with stakeholders to drive business outcomes.

  • CA ANZ or CPA qualified, or working towards completion.
  • Experience in management accounting, commercial finance or business partnering roles.
  • Exposure to construction, property, infrastructure, development or other project-based environments is highly desirable.
  • Strong financial modelling, budgeting and forecasting capability.
  • Proven ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders across operational and leadership teams.
  • Strong commercial judgement with the confidence to provide constructive challenge and recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate financial information into practical business insights.

Additional Information:

Why join us? 

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, development and construction, partnering with experienced leaders on projects that deliver lasting value. You'll gain exposure to significant investment decisions, complex commercial challenges and a diverse portfolio of development activity, while working within a collaborative team that values continuous improvement, commercial excellence and delivering great outcomes.

We also offer a competitive salary and a range of benefits on offer including day-to-day Health insurance, professional development opportunities, an annual entitlement of Summerset shares, wide range of supplier discounts, long service leave, a day off on your birthday and much more!

If you're looking for a role where you can combine business partnering, commercial analysis and strategic thinking while making a tangible impact, we'd love to hear from you.
